claims.statement: Projecting 40 to 45 store openings for the current year.

claims.statement: Anticipating a store opening run rate of 40 to 60 stores over the next three years.
claims.quote: So, you can take a range of 40 to 60 over the next three years.

claims.statement: Expecting gross margins to play around 14% to 15%.

facts.statement: Around 40% to 45% of DMart Ready home deliveries happen within 12 hours.

facts.statement: Approximately 86% of DMart Ready deliveries happen within 24 hours.
facts.quote: And about 86% of our deliveries happen within 24 hours, and then balance 14%, why it doesn't happen is because customers plan the date of delivery.

facts.statement: Apparel is a talent-driven and individual-driven category.
facts.quote: Apparel is very, very talent driven and individual driven - the guy or the lady who's running that specific category, how he or she thinks about what should be done.
